title: Business Central 29: Match Production Database Configuration in Sandbox Environments
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 introduces Match Production Configuration, an Admin Center action that temporarily adjusts a sandbox database to resemble production configuration for 72 hours. This helps partners and developers test extension performance and behavior more accurately by reducing the gap between sandbox and production environments.
key_points: Sandbox databases can be configured to match production database settings in the Admin Center for 72-hour periods
Feature enables more accurate performance testing, extension development, and cloud migration validation
Limited to 3 activations per tenant per calendar month with automatic reversion after 72 hours
Requires environment restart and disconnects active users during activation
Automation available through Admin Center API for integrated testing workflows

quotes.text: Match Production Configuration, a new Admin Center action that temporarily adjusts a sandbox database's configuration to resemble that of a typical production database.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clearly defines what the feature does and its purpose for creating production-like test environments

quotes.text: The three-activations-per-month limit applies to the entire tenant, so it's worth planning your testing windows.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights a critical resource constraint that affects testing strategy and planning
